title: CompareResponse
description: GlucoTwin contract v1.0.0 — generated from contracts/openapi.yaml by contracts/build_schemas.py. Do not edit by hand.

caveat.description: Mandatory interpretive caveat. Clients MUST display it verbatim.

DataSource.description:
Provenance label attached to every record and every forecast. `synthetic_dev` is
the team's development fixture data and must be displayed as such. `official` is
the organizer-supplied dataset.

Driver.description:
A model-attribution term, not a causal physiological claim. For the linear model
family, contributions form an exact additive decomposition of the predicted
excursion at the reported horizon.

feature.description: Feature name, or `participant_calibration` for the personalization offset.

contribution_mg_dl.description: Signed contribution to the predicted excursion, in mg/dL.

explanation.description: Plain-language statement of what the number means and does not mean.

ForecastMetrics.description:
Summary statistics derived from the 25 sampled `points`. These are computed from
the returned curve, never predicted independently, so they are always mutually
consistent with `points`.

peak_delta_mg_dl.description: `peak_mg_dl` minus baseline glucose at minute 0. May be <= 0.

time_to_peak_minutes.description: Minute of the peak. On ties, the EARLIEST minute wins.

incremental_auc_mg_dl_min.description:
Positive incremental AUC in mg/dL*min: five-minute trapezoidal integration of
max(predicted glucose - baseline glucose, 0) over minutes 0..120.
This is strictly non-negative and is NOT signed net excursion.

model_version.description: Version of the artifact that produced this forecast.

points.description:
EXACTLY 25 points at minutes 0, 5, 10, ..., 120 inclusive, in strictly
ascending minute order. Minute 0 is the measured pre-meal baseline glucose,
not a model output.

glucose_at_minutes.description:
Convenience read-out of the four required horizons. DERIVED from `points` by
exact minute lookup, never independently generated. Keys are strings.

drivers.description:
Ranked by absolute contribution, descending. MAY be empty `[]` when the loaded
model family does not support attribution; in that case `limitations` says so.
An empty list is honest; a fabricated list is a P1 defect.

limitations.description:
Human-readable caveats that the client MUST surface. Always contains at least
the research-use disclaimer. When `prediction_status` is
`generalized_fallback`, the first entry states the fallback reason.

PredictionStatus.description:
Whether the returned forecast used participant-specific calibration.
- `personalized`: the participant had at least the configured minimum number of
  training meal episodes, and a shrunk per-participant correction was applied.
- `generalized_fallback`: the cohort-level model was used alone. The reason is
  stated as the first entry in `limitations`.

UncertaintyStatus.description:
- `not_calibrated`: no empirically validated interval exists. `lower_mg_dl` and
  `upper_mg_dl` MUST be `null` and clients MUST NOT draw a band.
- `empirical_holdout`: bounds derive from measured held-out residual quantiles whose
  coverage was computed and is reported in `GET /api/model/metrics`.
